verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, and event subscriptions via webhooks are a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Slack/GitHub integration that brings messages into kanban and returns responses to the source thread is a chat/issue integration, not a webhook subscription. The local read-only views do not provide event callbacks either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
